items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember Lee Konitz because I went there with a friend of mine, and she said to Lee “Oh Mr. Konitz, what kind of saxophone do you play?”

ctx.x: Do you recall any of the musicians you encountered at The Loft?

Paul Bley, Lee Konitz, umm... I remember Lee Konitz because I went there with a friend of mine, and she said to Lee “Oh Mr. Konitz, what kind of saxophone do you play?” And he said “Wurlitzer”. And I went “Oh God, I’ve got to protect this girl.” Don’t let her out again.
